class.name: HTMLLIElement
class.brief_description: A handle to an HTML list item.
class.description: Represents a [code]<li>[/code] element in a list.

members.member: The reflected legacy marker type for this item. CSS can override it.
The explicit item number in an ordered list. Reading a missing or invalid [code]value[/code] attribute returns [code]0[/code]. Use [method HTMLElement.remove_attribute] to resume automatic numbering.
